content.value_statement: Frontend work often needs consistent React patterns, performance checks, and project scaffolding. This skill gives Claude and compatible agents practical guidance and local helper scripts for modern web application development.
actual_capabilities: Guides React and Next.js feature development with documented patterns.
Provides component generation workflow guidance for reusable UI work.
Supports bundle analysis workflows through a local Python helper script.
Documents frontend performance, security, and maintainability practices.
Provides setup, quality check, troubleshooting, and command reference sections.
limitations: The included Python scripts are lightweight templates and do not perform deep real analysis by default.
The reference documents contain generic examples, not framework-specific implementation details for every project.
Users must review generated or suggested code before applying it to production.
The skill does not replace browser testing, accessibility testing, or performance profiling tools.

use_cases.title: Create a reusable React component
use_cases.description: Use the skill to plan props, structure files, and align the component with project conventions.

use_cases.title: Review a Next.js performance issue
use_cases.description: Ask for a structured review of rendering, bundle size, caching, and loading behavior.

use_cases.title: Standardize frontend project setup
use_cases.description: Use the scaffolding guidance to create a consistent baseline for teams starting new web work.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a new component
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for structured UI planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a React component for this feature. Include props, state needs, accessibility checks, and test ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an existing page
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for targeted frontend improvements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Next.js page for maintainability, loading behavior, and user experience. Suggest focused improvements only.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze frontend performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this frontend flow for bundle size, rendering cost, caching, and Core Web Vitals risks. Prioritize fixes by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Create a frontend implementation plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for team-ready delivery planning.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation plan for this frontend feature. Cover architecture, component boundaries, data flow, testing, and rollout risks.

output_examples.input: Review my dashboard page for frontend quality.
output: A prioritized review of rendering risks, component structure, accessibility gaps, and test coverage.
Clear next steps that separate quick fixes from larger refactors.

output_examples.input: Help me build a reusable form component.
output: A component plan with props, validation behavior, error states, accessibility requirements, and usage guidance.
Testing suggestions for keyboard flow, invalid input, and loading states.

output_examples.input: Find ways to reduce the JavaScript bundle size.
output: A bundle review checklist covering dependencies, dynamic imports, route splitting, and measurement steps.
A short action list ordered by likely performance impact.

best_practices: Use the skill with a specific file, component, route, or performance goal.
Run project tests and browser checks after applying frontend changes.
Treat the helper scripts as local tools and review output paths before writing files.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for broad rewrites when a focused component fix is enough.
Do not apply performance changes without measuring before and after.
Do not treat generic reference examples as production-ready code without adaptation.

faq.question: What frameworks does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and common modern frontend workflows.

faq.question: Can it generate production-ready components?
faq.answer: It can guide component structure and implementation, but users should review, test, and adapt all output.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: The skill documents commands and includes scripts, but execution depends on the user or host agent workflow.

faq.question: Is it useful for performance work?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides performance review guidance and a simple bundle analysis workflow for local projects.

faq.question: Does it include security guidance?
faq.answer: Yes. The references mention input validation, authentication, authorization, and data protection practices.

faq.question: What should I verify after using it?
faq.answer: Verify behavior in the browser, run tests, check accessibility, and measure performance where relevant.
